bio: Fashion, evening wear and the minutes backstage. Tailoring, silk and a camera that loves a good coat. Adults only.
avatar: Portrait of an elegant woman in her mid 30s with dark hair in a low bun and red lipstick, black silk evening dress, moody studio light, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person, clearly an adult
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a fashion atelier with garments on rails and soft golden spotlights, an elegant silhouette in the middle band, cinematic
